'''2004 New Jersey Open Qualifier''' was a Star Wars CCG Open Qualifier for the [[2004 World Championship]], played on Saturday 14 August 2004 at Dark Tower Games in Denville, New Jersey. It was the last chance qualifier before the World Championship at Gen Con, with two Day 2 seats and the Players Committee's "Ultimate Package" of prizes, including the design of a virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3634">[https://web.archive.org/web/20040822082026/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?t=3634&amp Updated - Open Qualifier 8/14/04 in New Jersey], Scott Lingrell (director's report, 14 August 2004), Player's Committee Forums, swccgpc.com. Internet Archive capture 22 August 2004.</ref> [[Scott Lingrell]] directed it. 27 players took part, including two from Germany ([[Chris Menzel]] and Enno Haede). After six games [[Michael Dalton|Mike Dalton]] and [[Greg Shaw]] were first and second; the players chose not to play the final confrontation, and Dalton awarded Shaw the grand prize of designing a virtual card.<ref name="pcf-3634" />

== Format ==

* '''Environment:''' [[Premiere - Original VS6]] (from the card pool legal on the event date)
* '''Site:''' Dark Tower Games, Denville, New Jersey<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Dates:''' 14 August 2004<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Tournament director:''' [[Scott Lingrell]]<ref name="pcf-3634" />
* '''Players:''' 27<ref name="pcf-3634" />

The report counts 15 distinct Light Side and 13 Dark Side deck types, including five Imperial Occupation (V) and five CCT decks on the Dark Side. Items were auctioned during the day for the Players Committee. A Friday "Gauntlet" event was announced and then cancelled.<ref name="pcf-3634" /> Entry was $10; registration opened at 10am and play began at 11am. The event was six games with a final confrontation, and the "Ultimate Package" of prizes included the design of a Virtual Card, uncut sheets, two seats at the 2004 World Championships, signed cards and t-shirts.<ref name="pcf-3634-51901">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51901#51901 Updated - Open Qualifier 8/14/04 in New Jersey], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (2 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819030114/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50430%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> The Friday 13 August Gauntlet was to pit challengers, each playing a random deck and side, against [[Chris Gogolen]], [[Greg Shaw]] and a third player with an assortment of decks; a challenger who beat all three won $20, and every challenger received a pack of cards. It was cancelled because of scheduling conflicts.<ref name="pcf-3634-51901" /> The auction during the day, with all of the money going to the Players Committee for future expenses and prize money, offered signed Mara Jade, Darth Vader, Boba Fett and Owen Lars cards, limited edition RamapoCon 3 and tournament t-shirts, uncut sheets and EPP Maul and Qui-Gon cards, among other items.<ref name="pcf-3634-51976">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=51976#51976 Updated - Open Qualifier 8/14/04 in New Jersey], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (4 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819030114/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50430%26amp Internet Archive]</ref> Players came from New York, Connecticut, New Jersey, Pennsylvania and Maryland as well as Germany; [[Frank Walsh]] and [[Joseph Gagliardi|Joe Gagliardi]] played for the first time in over a year, one player used [[Observation Holocam]], and Chris Gogolen donated a box of white-border Premiere he had found at home.<ref name="pcf-3634-52653">[http://www.swccgpc.com/forums/viewtopic.php?p=52653#52653 Updated - Open Qualifier 8/14/04 in New Jersey], Scott Lingrell, Players Committee forum, swccgpc.com (14 August 2004). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20040819030114/http://www.swccgpc.com:80/forums/viewtopic.php?p=50430%26amp Internet Archive]</ref>
